Methanol Institute and studio Gear Up (2022). Carbon Footprint of Methanol. Methanol Institute, Singapore and Washington DC.

Industry-association life-cycle (RED II) assessment from data supplied by 12 producers. Loaded: the facility (production-process) emissions of modern natural-gas methanol plants, 400 g CO2-eq/kg. NOT loaded: everything else is life-cycle (upstream gas, end-of-life, bio- and e-methanol, coal) or read from charts. Traps: (1) 20 g/MJ is per MJ LHV of methanol (19.9 MJ/kg), equal to the printed 400 g/kg; (2) four new plants, not a fleet average; (3) whether purchased electricity is in the facility figure is not stated.
